finding: A bibliographic conflict now blocks treating the 1955 v.3/p.377 identification as settled. NYU ACO gives its specific volume-3 object a 1955 date and scans it, while another academic bibliography describes the third volume as issued by الهيئة المصرية العامة للكتاب in 1972 after vols. 1-2 (Cairo, Dār al-Kutub al-Miṣrīyah, 1955). Dar al-Kutub's catalog groups all three parts under 1955. These records may describe distinct publication/printing histories or cataloging conventions; without the relevant title pages and printed p.377, they cannot be harmonized.
